findings.title: SSRF-adjacent host validation using referer header is unreliable
findings.body: The ensure_embeddable check compares request.referer host against SiteSetting.embeddable_host, but relies entirely on the Referer header which is attacker-controllable (can be omitted or spoofed by many clients) and doesn't validate the embed_url param itself against embeddable_host. An attacker could craft requests without a Referer or spoof it, then supply any embed_url to trigger retrieval of arbitrary external URLs via the retrieve_topic job (TopicRetriever eventually checks embed_url host too, but only after enqueuing the job, consuming resources and running an HTTP fetch of attacker-chosen URLs limited by one host check in topic_retriever). This is weak defense-in-depth and should also validate embed_url's host explicitly in the controller.

findings.title: Open redirect / SSRF via import_remote fetching arbitrary URLs
findings.body: fetch_http calls TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, @embed_url) which does `open(url).read` (open-uri). Although invalid_host? restricts @embed_url's host to embeddable_host, open-uri can still follow redirects to internal addresses (SSRF) since Ruby's open-uri by default does not restrict redirect targets. This can be used to probe internal network resources if embeddable_host's server redirects to internal IPs. No protection against redirects to non-http(s) schemes or internal addresses is implemented.

findings.title: No validation of PostCreator result before use in revisor path
findings.body: In TopicEmbed.import, when embed already exists, post = embed.post. If embed.post has been deleted/trashed independently (post_id orphaned), the subsequent revisor.revise!(user, ...) will raise against nil, with no guard. This should check post presence before attempting revision.

findings.title: skip_validations changes save behavior silently for existing revise! callers
findings.body: update_post now calls `@post.save(validate: !@opts[:skip_validations])` instead of plain `@post.save`. This changes behavior for all existing callers of PostRevisor#revise! that don't pass skip_validations (defaults to validating, same as before), but any caller relying on validate: true default behavior combined with other opts could be affected if skip_validations is inadvertently truthy from merged opts hashes elsewhere. Worth confirming no other code paths pass skip_validations unintentionally given it's a now-functional flag change.

findings.title: Potential nil content causes crash when RSS content missing
findings.body: `i.content.scrub` assumes i.content is always present; if an RSS/Atom item lacks a content/description field, i.content will be nil and `.scrub` raises NoMethodError, crashing the whole feed polling for all items (no per-item rescue), potentially breaking poll_feed job for the entire batch due to one malformed item.
